from pathlib import Path

def summarize(path):
    total=0
    sig=0
    up=0
    down=0
    skipped=0
    with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        for line in fh:
            line=line.rstrip('\\n')
            if not line:
                continue
            total += 1
            fields=line.split('\\t')
            if len(fields) < 6:
                skipped += 1
                continue
            try:
                base=float(fields[1]); lfc=float(fields[2]); p=float(fields[4])
            except ValueError:
                skipped += 1
                continue
            if base > 10 and abs(lfc) > 1 and p < 0.05:
                sig += 1
                if lfc > 1: up += 1
                elif lfc < -1: down += 1
    return total,sig,up,down,skipped
full=summarize('/workspace/galaxy_downloads/full_deseq.tsv')
reduced=summarize('/workspace/galaxy_downloads/reduced_deseq.tsv')
print('full_total=%d full_sig=%d full_up=%d full_down=%d full_skipped=%d' % full)
print('reduced_total=%d reduced_sig=%d reduced_up=%d reduced_down=%d reduced_skipped=%d' % reduced)
print('difference=%d direction=%s' % (reduced[1]-full[1], 'increase' if reduced[1]>full[1] else 'decrease' if reduced[1]<full[1] else 'no change'))
